narration:0:1660120001:0.text: Thanks to Mikola, the Bloomtide Market has been transformed.
narration:0:1660120001:0.source_cn: 在曼卡拉的热情帮助下，春鲜集市很快焕然一新

say:2:1660120002:0.text: The market is bigger and livelier! Gotta hand it to Mikola!
say:2:1660120002:0.source_cn: 春鲜集市变得更大更华丽了！真不愧是曼卡拉！

say:3:1660120003:0.text: I'm honestly impressed. It's wild how a few red fruits can make the whole place feel like a celebration.
say:3:1660120003:0.source_cn: 哇……真没想到，只用几种红色的果子就能塑造出这么强的节...

say:5:1660120004:0.text: Naturally! Every Warsong Festival display is my handiwork.
say:5:1660120004:0.source_cn: 当然了！每一届战歌节的装饰可都是由我亲自操办的！

say:7:1660120005:0.text: Warsong Festival? Sounds like another fun holiday.
say:7:1660120005:0.source_cn: 战歌节？听起来又是一个有趣的节日。

say:8:1660120006:0.text: Told you. Visiting <style="stress"><player_name></style> always leads to something new.
say:8:1660120006:0.male: Told you. Visiting <style="stress"><player_name></style> always leads to something new.
say:8:1660120006:0.female: Told you. Visiting <style="stress"><player_name></style> always leads to something new.

say:9:1660120007:0.text: You just don't want to deal with your backlog of work.
say:9:1660120007:0.source_cn: 你只是不想处理堆积的工作而已。

say:10:1660120008:1.source_cn: 这么欢乐的时刻，就不要提工作的事了。

say:11:1660120009:1.text: Alright now. Here's to this once-a-year festival and to <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s hospitality!
say:11:1660120009:1.source_cn: 来吧，朋友们，为了庆祝这难得的节日，也为了感谢<sty...
say:11:1660120009:1.male: Alright now. Here's to this once-a-year festival and to <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s hospitality!
say:11:1660120009:1.female: Alright now. Here's to this once-a-year festival and to <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s hospitality!

narration:12:1660120010:0.text: Before long, everyone is settled in, enjoying the feast while trading stories.
narration:12:1660120010:0.source_cn: 众人终于放松下来，一边享受美食一边谈天说地

narration:13:1660120011:0.text: And more guests arrive in Avalon...
narration:13:1660120011:0.source_cn: 没过多久，又有几人抵达了阿瓦隆……
